subject.title: [Task] Harden browser/search stack and evaluate Lightpanda

question: Should this broad browser/search hardening task stay as one maintainer-owned project, or be split before implementation into search-provider fixes, browser/Lightpanda backend evaluation, and benchmark-matrix work?
rationale: The remaining work crosses security boundaries, optional browser backend direction, and test-matrix design, so automation cannot safely choose the product scope or trust model.

options.title: Split Before Implementation
options.body: Keep this issue open for maintainer scoping, then move concrete work into smaller issues or PRs with explicit security contracts and validation matrices.

options.title: Keep As Umbrella
options.body: Treat this issue as a maintainer-owned project tracker and require human review before any implementation PR touches browser/search runtime paths.

options.title: Close Into Narrow Trackers
options.body: Close this after maintainers create or designate separate canonical issues for the browser backend, search-provider reliability, and benchmark matrix pieces.

recommendation.title: Split Before Implementation
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open for maintainer scoping, then move concrete work into smaller issues or PRs with explicit security contracts and validation matrices.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has recent history across the sandbox browser helper docs and SearXNG/web-search hardening paths and was mentioned on the live issue timeline.
